What do other customers say in their reviews, does it actually hold up?CarBahnCustomers have shared positive experiences with the 513 HP Stage 1 Performance Controller.

Kyle N. highlights its seamless drivability and quick response, noting it enhances the mid-to-upper RPM range.
Gary O. praises the smooth power delivery and mentions the exciting sound changes, making it perfect for track use.
513 HP Stage 1 Performance Controller | BMW F87 M2 Competition$595$7954.5(2)Kyle N.Verified Buyer5.0I’ve been eyeing this for some time - once I saw the May sale, I decided to pull the trigger on this purchase and I’m so glad I did! 

While I’ve only had about 2-3 drives since install, there a few immediately noticeable things about this product. First (and most importantly), drivability remains the same as stock. I daily my M2 Competition and this is an important factor to me. I can drive this modestly and when I want to get on the gas pedal the car MOVES. The mid-to-upper end of the RPM range feels so much more alive and quick. If you’re not careful, you’ll quickly find yourself going faster than the speed limit. 

Install took me about ~1. 5hrs, but if I were to do it again I think I could knock it out in about ~30 min or less. The troubling part of install for me was hooking up the cam sensor at the front of the engine. I refused to remove any additional parts in the engine bay and there is only a small window to work with. This is really a BMW design issue, not a Carbahn issue. Overall, there are 3 sensors that need to be connected in the engine bay, along with a handful of zip ties to tidy things up. The linked install video was very easy to follow along with - it does suggest potentially having to remove the intercooler, but I didn’t have to. 

The app is super easy to use. Set it once and forget it - unless you’re changing octanes or want to mess around with the various maps for each octane level. I’m currently running 91 octane (best readily available in AZ) with significantly better performance. I can only imagine what running 100 octane would do to this car - I will try it sometime when gas prices simmer down. 

Highly recommend this for anyone looking to give their car some new life and added performance while maintaining drivability!Gary O.Verified Buyer4.0The installation was significantly more challenging than the video let me believe. You need to remove a lot of adjacent piping and the intercooler reservoir in order to clip in the required sensor plugs. Video did not accurately show this. However, once the unit was installed and paired to the App. . . . . . . . . . WOW! The power and even the engine sounded completely different. It was like unleashing a Turbo Monster. Fantastic boost and no Turbo lag, just smooth and consistent power delivery. I could clearly hear the wastegate blow-off. No silly burbles required. This is going to be a real fun ride at the track, I can't wait.
